```sql
WITH nj_region AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'New Jersey'
    AND border_type = 'state'
),
longest_road_in_nj AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.geometry, r.road_name
  FROM roads r
  JOIN nj_region n ON ST_Intersects(r.geometry::geometry, n.geometry::geometry)
  ORDER BY ST_Length(r.geometry::geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
road_raster_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      1,
      (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM longest_road_in_nj)
  ) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
      r.rast::geometry,
      (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM longest_road_in_nj)
  )
),
road_elevation_profile AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Value(clipped_raster, ST_StartPoint(road_geom)) AS start_elevation,
    ST_Value(clipped_raster, ST_EndPoint(road_geom)) AS end_elevation,
    ST_Length(road_geom) AS road_length
  FROM road_raster_clip
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT geometry::geometry AS road_geom
    FROM longest_road_in_nj
  ) AS geom
),
road_slope AS (
  SELECT
    (end_elevation - start_elevation) / (road_length / 1000) AS slope_percent
  FROM road_elevation_profile
)
SELECT
  (SELECT road_name FROM longest_road_in_nj) AS road_name,
  slope_percent
FROM road_slope;
```
